obligations.description: - `Prompt_Pipeline.md` still allows `persona_override_owner_id` scope values that include `tier_id`, which is increasingly a legacy ownership key for Orchestrator execution. That likely needs a migration path toward run/node/attempt/subagent-owned scopes.
exact_items: - `Prompt_Pipeline.md` still allows `persona_override_owner_id` scope values that include `tier_id`, which is increasingly a legacy ownership key for Orchestrator execution. That likely needs a migration path toward run/node/attempt/subagent-owned scopes.
